problem:
Which of the following equations has no solutions for $0\le x<2\pi ?$

- $5-\operatorname{csc}⁡x=4\operatorname{csc}⁡x$
- $\sqrt{2}\operatorname{csc}⁡x=2-\sqrt{2}\operatorname{csc}⁡x$
- $5\operatorname{csc}⁡x-3=-2$

feedback.problem: Given that ${x}_{1}$ and ${x}_{2}$ are the solutions to the equation $\operatorname{csc}⁡x=-\frac{8}{5}$ for ${0}^{∘}\le x<{360}^{∘},$ what is the numerical value of ${x}_{1}\cdot {x}_{2},$ rounded to the nearest integer?
feedback.worked_solution:
Recall that $\operatorname{csc}⁡x=\frac{1}{\operatorname{sin}⁡x},$ therefore the given equation is equivalent to

$$
\operatorname{sin}⁡x=-\frac{5}{8}.
$$

Now, we find the principal value:

$$
x=\operatorname{arcsin}⁡(-\frac{5}{8})=(-38.682\,1…)^{∘}≈-{38.682}^{∘}
$$

This value is outside the required domain. To get a value inside the range, we add ${360}^{∘}.$

$$
{x}_{1}=-{38.682}^{∘}+{360}^{∘}={321.318}^{∘}
$$

So, our first solution is ${x}_{1}={321.318}^{∘}.$

Our first solution lies in the fourth quadrant and has a reference angle of ${\theta }_{R}={38.682}^{∘}.$ Since $\operatorname{sin}⁡x<0,$ the second solution must lie in the third quadrant, and it also has a reference angle ${\theta }_{R}={38.682}^{∘}.$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14041597/assets/f4ddf01db733d5ee2e73a4b8abb0bec84d9ee2f7be0fea03e99c112456be1c14.png)

Since the second solution ${x}_{2}$ lies in the $3$rd quadrant, we can find it using the reference angle as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{2} & ={180}^{∘}+{\theta }_{R} \\  & ={180}^{∘}+{38.682}^{∘} \\  & ={218.682}^{∘}\end{aligned}
$$

Finally,

$$
{x}_{1}\cdot {x}_{2}=321.318\cdot 218.682≈70\,266
$$

rounded to the nearest integer.
